visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a navy and white horizontally striped polo shirt, stands outdoors on a paved walkway. He holds a pink-cased smartphone in his left hand and scrolls with his right thumb, looking down with a focused yet slightly pained expression. The background features green manicured bushes and a modern white building with a gridded facade under bright natural daylight. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a parking lot. A yellow mechanical ground lock labeled 'USPACE' with a QR code rises from a flat position in a numbered parking space '5'. A blue and white sign in the background indicates it is a shared parking spot with pricing information. The ground is grey asphalt with yellow and black tire stoppers. (3) The scene returns to the man. He holds the phone closer to the camera to display a digital screen showing a 'Fee Breakdown' with the total amount '$2345' highlighted by yellow graphic sparkles. He points his right index finger at the screen, looking at the camera with a wide-eyed, frustrated smile. (4) He raises his left hand, spreading four fingers to emphasize a point while still holding the phone. He continues to look directly at the camera, gesturing animatedly with his hands while speaking. The background remains the same outdoor garden area with lush greenery. (5) In the final phase, he gives a 'thumbs up' gesture with his right hand toward the camera, tilting his head slightly and smiling. The camera remains eye-level and static throughout most of these shots, with quick cuts between the speaker and the insert of the parking lock.
